XTenant.name: X-Tenant
XTenant.description: Restaurant slug. Optional when the token already belongs to a restaurant — the token wins, and a header naming a different restaurant is tenant.mismatch. Required in production for tokens that belong to none.

XBranch.name: X-Branch
XBranch.description: Branch slug. Absent means every branch of the restaurant — an owner reading totals — not a missing value.

XLocale.name: X-Locale
XLocale.description: Wins over the user preference and Accept-Language.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated key, one per operation. The same key replays the stored response verbatim (Idempotent-Replay: true); the same key with a different body is request.idempotency_key_reused.

field.description: Present when one input field is to blame.

retryable.description: True: same request may succeed later. False: change something first.

auth.forbidden.message_uz: Sizda bu amal uchun ruxsat yo'q. Menejerga murojaat qiling.
auth.forbidden.message_ru: У вас нет прав на это действие. Обратитесь к менеджеру.
auth.forbidden.message_en: You do not have permission for this. Ask a manager.

auth.invalid_credentials.message_en: Those sign-in details are not correct.

auth.pin_locked.message_uz: Hisob qulflandi. PIN ni menejer tiklaydi.
auth.pin_locked.message_ru: Учётная запись заблокирована. PIN сбрасывает менеджер.
auth.pin_locked.message_en: This account is locked. A manager must reset the PIN.

bots.invalid_token.message_en: That internal token is not valid.

bots.token_not_configured.message_ru: Внутренний токен для ботов не настроен.
bots.token_not_configured.message_en: The internal bot token is not configured.

bots.unknown_key.message_uz: Bunday bot kaliti yo'q yoki restoran faol emas.
bots.unknown_key.message_ru: Такого ключа бота нет, или ресторан неактивен.
bots.unknown_key.message_en: No such bot key, or its restaurant is not active.

branch.mismatch.message_uz: Siz boshqa filial ma'lumotiga kira olmaysiz.
branch.mismatch.message_ru: Вы не можете обращаться к данным другого филиала.
branch.mismatch.message_en: You cannot reach another branch's data.

crm.address_limit_reached.message_uz: Manzillar soni chegarasiga yetdingiz. Bittasini o'chiring.
crm.address_limit_reached.message_ru: Достигнут предел числа адресов. Удалите один.
crm.address_limit_reached.message_en: You have reached the address limit. Delete one first.

crm.amount_invalid.message_en: That is not a usable amount.

crm.campaign_already_sent.message_uz: Bu kampaniya allaqachon yuborilgan — uni o'zgartirib bo'lmaydi.
crm.campaign_already_sent.message_ru: Эта кампания уже отправлена — изменить её нельзя.
crm.campaign_already_sent.message_en: This campaign has already gone out and cannot be changed.

crm.campaign_no_recipients.message_uz: Bu segmentda telefon raqami bor birorta mijoz yo'q.
crm.campaign_no_recipients.message_ru: В этом сегменте нет ни одного клиента с номером телефона.
crm.campaign_no_recipients.message_en: Nobody in this segment has a phone number.

crm.case_already_decided.message_ru: На эту жалобу уже дан ответ.
crm.case_already_decided.message_en: This complaint has already been answered.

crm.case_needs_manager.message_uz: Bu summa uchun menejer tasdig'i kerak.
crm.case_needs_manager.message_ru: Для этой суммы нужно подтверждение менеджера.
crm.case_needs_manager.message_en: A manager has to approve an amount this size.

crm.charge_conflict.message_uz: Bu hisob allaqachon boshqa summaga qarzga yozilgan.
crm.charge_conflict.message_ru: Этот счёт уже записан в долг на другую сумму.
crm.charge_conflict.message_en: This bill is already on the tab for a different amount.

crm.coupon_already_held.message_ru: Этот купон у вас уже есть.

crm.coupon_not_found.message_uz: Bunday kupon yo'q yoki muddati tugagan.
crm.coupon_not_found.message_ru: Такого купона нет или срок его действия истёк.
crm.coupon_not_found.message_en: No such coupon, or it has ended.

crm.credit_limit_exceeded.message_uz: Kredit limitidan oshadi — menejer tasdig'i kerak.
crm.credit_limit_exceeded.message_ru: Превышен кредитный лимит — нужно подтверждение менеджера.
crm.credit_limit_exceeded.message_en: Over the credit limit — a manager has to approve it.

crm.customer_blocked.message_uz: Bu hisob to'xtatilgan. Restoran bilan bog'laning.

crm.customer_inactive.message_uz: Mijoz faol emas — uning balansiga yozib bo'lmaydi.

crm.customer_inactive.message_en: The guest is not active — nothing can go on their tab.

crm.customer_token_expired.message_en: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

crm.customer_token_required.message_uz: Bu amal uchun hisobga kirish kerak.

crm.customer_token_required.message_en: You need to be signed in for this.

crm.no_credit_account.message_uz: Bu mijozga qarzga sotish ochilmagan. Limitni menejer qo'yadi.

crm.otp_expired.message_ru: Срок действия кода истёк. Запросите новый.
